subject: Guardian Accelerator — request for dynamic credit top-up / waiver
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@guardianai.co>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nambiar <priya.n@guardianai.co>
Date: Sun, 9 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: accelerator credits - temporary top‑up/waiver during demo week

Hi Vanessa,

Quick context — we run the Guardian Accelerator (40 teams this semester). We love Redwood for inference speed but usage during Demo Week spikes 5-8x for the teams doing live showcases. Our finance team is asking if Redwood can provide a one-time dynamic credit top-up (or temporary waiver) to cover Demo Week consumption for 10 of the teams.

Specific ask: 150k token credit pool for Demo Week (Nov 25–29) that sits outside our normal promo allocation. We can commit to a short-term conversion path (6 month post-demo credit conversion to committed usage or a billing top-up) but need the burst protection now.

I’ve attached our accelerator MAP draft and a short SOC2 snapshot for context. Would appreciate a quick yes/no today so we can confirm program comms.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Rao
Head of Programs, GuardianAI
mobile: +1 415‑555‑0198

Attachments:
- Guardian-MAP-draft.pdf (MAP timeline and team list)
- SOC2-snapshot.pdf (security summary)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@guardianai.co>
Cc: Priya Nambiar <priya.n@guardianai.co>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator credits - temporary top‑up/waiver during demo week

Hi Samir — thanks for the context and the attachments. Short answer: likely yes, but we need to structure it so it’s predictable and low risk for Redwood.

Proposal (high level):
- One-time 150k token “demo buffer” applied for Nov 25–29.
- Condition: If usage exceeds the buffer, additional tokens billed at a reduced demo rate (50% off list) for the overage.
- Conversion path: If Guardian converts any of the 10 teams to Dedicated within 6 months, we will credit up to 60% of the buffer against the first month’s committed usage (soft credit; requires minimal contract language).
- Approval needed from Commercial (Ben) for the credit and from Billing for the accounting treatment.

I’ve looped in Ben here to confirm we can execute the accounting/discount side and to surface any compliance flags. If you’re ok, we’ll draft a short MAP addendum and a one‑page terms rider.

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Exec — Startups & Accelerators
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Guardian-MAP-draft.pdf

Vanessa — thanks for the heads up. I reviewed the MAP and the ask. A few operational points before we commit: 

1) Accounting: we need to classify the 150k as a promotional allowance (contra‑revenue) and cap total promotional exposure to $5k for this account this FY unless leadership signs off.
2) Risk: if Guardian offloads the overage to Redwood without conversion, we need an explicit repayment path or auto-bill at the discounted rate.
3) Legal: clean, one‑page rider that references the main MSA and a simple conversion credit schedule. I can greenlight the promo allowance if Legal and Finance get a 24h turnaround on the rider and a confirmed HubSpot deal record.

I’ll approve the approach conditional on those items. Looping Laura to own the playbook for promo accounting treatment and to help draft the rider.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Hi Samir / Priya — appreciate the patience while we lined up internal approvals. Below is the agreed path and asks to operationalize before Nov 25.

What Redwood will provide:
- 150,000 token demo buffer active Nov 25–29, 2025 (applied account-level, allocated by your MAP team).
- If total Demo Week consumption exceeds 150k, overage billed automatically at 50% off Redwood public demo rates.
- Conversion credit: if any of the benefiting teams convert to a Dedicated contract within 6 months, Guardian will receive a one-time credit equal to 60% of the per-team portion of the buffer, applied to month 1 of the commitment.

What we need from Guardian by Nov 20 (deliverables):
1) Signed one‑page MAP addendum (I attached a draft).
2) Confirmation of the 10 team IDs (sheet in MAP PDF) so we can pre‑allocate the buffer.
3) Billing contact name + email for invoicing/overage processing.

Attachments: Guardian-MAP-draft.pdf (with addendum page appended)
Signed copy: please use the DocuSign link below to sign the rider if legal is ok. We will provision the buffer once HubSpot deal is updated with the expected demo dates and Billing contact.

Links:

- Sign MAP addendum: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-guardian-map

If you’d like, Ben or I can hop on a 15m call tomorrow to walk through the short addendum. Otherwise, sign and we’ll treat this as approved and provision the buffer.

Thanks — looking forward to Demo Week!
